images.description: The till mid-sale on Register 1 — a Confectionery product grid of real Australian lines with SKUs and prices on the left, three items building in the cart on the right with quantity steppers, and a running GST-inclusive subtotal underneath.
images.altText: POS till screen with product grid and three-item cart

images.description: The payment screen tendering a $12.30 sale — Cash, Card, Split and Other methods across the top, an amount keypad, and Australian note buttons from $5 to $100 plus Exact, with an open-till prompt once the cash is counted.
images.altText: Payment screen with cash denomination buttons and keypad

images.description: The store admin home for the Railway News Agency tenant — a tenant switcher up top, sales stat cards, a 'Pair till — required' banner and a POS entry button, the back office each newsagent manages on the shared platform.
images.altText: Multi-tenant store admin dashboard with tenant switcher

images.description: Step one of the add-product wizard, searching 'Banana' and matching against Open Food Facts and a Coles catalog by barcode — how a shop populates its catalogue from shared product data instead of typing every line by hand.
images.altText: Add-product wizard matching a barcode against catalog data

images.description: The add-store wizard's owner-details step, capturing company name, ABN, owner contact, Sydney timezone, AUD currency and Australia as the locked business country — the multi-store setup that stands up a new location under one organisation.
images.altText: Add-store wizard with ABN, AUD and Australian timezone fields

images.description: The desktop terminal's pairing screen, where a till links to a store by entering an eight-character Register ID and an activation code that expires after fifteen minutes — proof the terminal is a separate device, not a browser tab.
images.altText: POS terminal pairing screen with register ID and code fields

images.description: The reports section's sales dashboard, listing weekly earnings, payment breakdown, register sessions and a sidebar of documents including a GST/BAS summary — the reporting layer a newsagent owner uses to reconcile takings and prepare tax.
images.altText: Sales reports dashboard with GST and BAS summary links

images.description: The roles and permissions screen with four system roles — cashier, inventory staff, manager and owner — each showing its permission scopes and user count, the access model deciding what staff can do at the till and in admin.
images.altText: Roles and permissions table with four system roles

images.description: A line-item editor over the till for a Flat White, tabbed across Quantity, Price, Discount and Notes with a quick-quantity keypad and live line total — the per-item overrides a cashier applies without leaving the sale.
images.altText: Line-item edit modal with quantity, price and discount tabs

images.description: A quick product-setup slide-over showing sell price, supplier cost and margin for Banana chips, with an out-of-stock prompt and a stock-adjustment control that logs a reason — the inventory detail behind a single catalogue line.
images.altText: Product quick-setup panel with pricing and stock adjustment

images.description: The terminal's post-pairing sync step for Register 1, confirming the register is licensed, the catalog is synced and offering shared or custom home layouts before a cashier signs in and enters the opening cash float.
images.altText: Terminal sync screen confirming register and catalog status

images.description: The HRM user list mapping each staff member to a role — cashiers and the owner for this tenant — the roster of people the roles and permissions model governs, kept per store within the shared platform.
images.altText: Employee user management table with assigned roles

images.description: An analytics variant of the admin home with top-selling and low-stock panels, recent sales and an order-statistics heatmap — a denser overview that largely repeats the primary store dashboard's ground rather than adding a new surface.
images.altText: Analytics dashboard with top-selling and low-stock panels

images.description: The store dashboard sign-in screen on a dark backdrop with the DilPos mark, email and password fields and a create-account link — the routine authentication entry point, useful for completeness but carrying little product-specific weight.
images.altText: DilPos dark-themed store dashboard login screen
